mapper.select: /* Subcon01Mapper.selectRelationList */ SELECT R.RELATION_ID AS relationId , CASE WHEN R.REQ_CMPNY_CD = #{gvCmpnyCd} THEN 'SENT' ELSE 'RECEIVED' END AS direction , CASE WHEN R.REQ_CMPNY_CD = #{gvCmpnyCd} THEN R.TGT_CMPNY_CD ELSE R.REQ_CMPNY_CD END AS otherCmpnyCd , IFNULL(C.CMPNY_NM, '') AS otherCmpnyNm , R.STATUS AS status , DATE_FORMAT(R.INSERT_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS insertDate , DATE_FORMAT(R.PROCESS_DTIME, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS processDtime , R.PROCESS_COMMENT AS processComment FROM TB_CMPNY_RELATION R LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_CMPNY C ON ( C.CMPNY_CD = CASE WHEN R.REQ_CMPNY_CD = #{gvCmpnyCd} THEN R.TGT_CMPNY_CD ELSE R.REQ_CMPNY_CD END ) WHERE (R.REQ_CMPNY_CD = #{gvCmpnyCd} OR R.TGT_CMPNY_CD = #{gvCmpnyCd}) ORDER BY R.INSERT_DATE DESC, R.RELATION_ID DESC LIMIT #{limit}

/* Subcon01Mapper.selectRelationPartyRaw */ SELECT R.REQ_CMPNY_CD AS reqCmpnyCd , R.TGT_CMPNY_CD AS tgtCmpnyCd , R.STATUS AS status FROM TB_CMPNY_RELATION R WHERE R.RELATION_ID = #{relationId} AND (R.REQ_CMPNY_CD = #{gvCmpnyCd} OR R.TGT_CMPNY_CD = #{gvCmpnyCd})
/* Subcon01Mapper.selectRelationById */ SELECT R.REQ_CMPNY_CD AS reqCmpnyCd , R.TGT_CMPNY_CD AS tgtCmpnyCd , R.STATUS AS status FROM TB_CMPNY_RELATION R WHERE R.RELATION_ID = #{relationId}

/* Subcon01Mapper.selectRelationHists */ SELECT H.HIST_ID AS histId , H.ACTION_TYPE AS actionType , CASE WHEN H.ACTION_CMPNY_CD = #{gvCmpnyCd} THEN IFNULL(NULLIF(U.USER_NM, ''), H.ACTION_USER_CD) ELSE NULL END AS actionUserNm , DATE_FORMAT(H.ACTION_DTIME, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS actionDtime , H.ACTION_DESC AS actionDesc FROM TB_CMPNY_RELATION_HIST H LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_USER U ON ( U.CMPNY_CD = H.ACTION_CMPNY_CD AND U.USER_CD = H.ACTION_USER_CD AND H.ACTION_CMPNY_CD = #{gvCmpnyCd} ) WHERE H.RELATION_ID = #{relationId} /* 최신 이력이 위로 오도록 내림차순(2026-08-15 통합테스트 지적). 동시각 이력은 HIST_ID 역순으로 안정 정렬한다. */ ORDER BY H.ACTION_DTIME DESC, H.HIST_ID DESC

/* Subcon01Mapper.selectActivePairCntForUpdate */ SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_CMPNY_RELATION WHERE STATUS IN ('REQUESTED', 'ACCEPTED') AND ( (REQ_CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCdA} AND TGT_CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCdB}) OR (REQ_CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCdB} AND TGT_CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCdA}) ) FOR UPDATE ) T
